description: This Java class 'ICalWorker' handles WebDAV requests related to iCalendar data, including GET, PUT, and PROPFIND operations, for work effort entities in the OFBiz framework. It delegates calendar conversion tasks to 'ICalConverter' and manages HTTP responses and user authentication.

classes.name: ICalWorker
classes.description: A utility class for handling WebDAV requests related to iCalendar data, including GET, PUT, and PROPFIND methods, with support for user authentication and response management.

classes.name: ResponseProperties
classes.description: A simple data class encapsulating HTTP response status code and message.

methods.name: createConversionContext
methods.description: Creates a context map from the HTTP request attributes, parameters, and locale for calendar conversion.

methods.name: createForbiddenResponse
methods.description: Returns a ResponseProperties object indicating a 403 Forbidden status.

methods.name: createNotAuthorizedResponse
methods.description: Returns a ResponseProperties object indicating a 401 Unauthorized status.

methods.name: createNotFoundResponse
methods.description: Returns a ResponseProperties object indicating a 404 Not Found status.

methods.name: createOkResponse
methods.description: Returns a ResponseProperties object indicating a 200 OK status.

methods.name: createPartialContentResponse
methods.description: Returns a ResponseProperties object indicating a 206 Partial Content status.

methods.name: getLastModifiedDate
methods.description: Retrieves the last modified date of the work effort's iCalendar data.

methods.name: handleGetRequest
methods.description: Processes HTTP GET requests to retrieve iCalendar data for a work effort.

methods.name: handlePropFindRequest
methods.description: Handles WebDAV PROPFIND requests to retrieve properties of the iCalendar resource.

methods.name: handlePutRequest
methods.description: Processes HTTP PUT requests to update or create iCalendar data for a work effort.

methods.name: isValidRequest
methods.description: Validates the incoming request for security and proper parameters.

methods.name: logInUser
methods.description: Authenticates the user based on request credentials and sets user info in the request/session.

methods.name: setupRequest
methods.description: Initializes request attributes such as workEffortId and performs user login.

methods.name: writeResponse
methods.description: Writes the ResponseProperties to the HTTP response, setting headers and status.
